title: Upping My P(Bloom) — An Answer
timing_note: PLANNED timings from a 128 BPM grid (1 bar = 1.875 s). They will be replaced by measured onsets from the finished audio.
suno_spelling_note: For text-to-song tools, spell P-bloom as 'Pee-bloom' if the tool mispronounces it.

sections.name: Intro
lines: Everybody's upping their doom.
Cool. Cool cool cool.
I brought a shovel.

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Big scary chart on a big scary screen,
Everybody's sharing the worst they've seen,
Yes, the storm is real — I won't pretend,
But a forecast's a question, not “The End.”
Doom is weather — bloom is work,
Clouds can lurk, but I don't shirk,
Packed a lunch and a spade and a hat,
Brought my helper too — and that is that.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.direction: building, claps, then one beat of silence
lines: Worry's a fuel, not a place to stay,
Point it at something and go that way —
Ready? Ready? Count it in —
(One!) (Two!) (Three!)

sections.name: Chorus
lines: I'm upping my P-bloom! (Bloom!)
Nothing's written, nothing's doomed! (Nope!)
Rain is real and so is spring —
Grab a shovel, do the thing!
I'm upping my P-bloom! (Bloom!)
Humans and helpers, fill the room! (Room!)
Not “it's fine” — it's ours to do —
The dial moves when we move!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: They say “Shoggoth!” — okay, get a light,
Crack it open, read it in daylight,
They say “Paperclips!” — fine, write it down,
Test it, poke it, turn it upside-down,
They say “FOOM!” — cool, where are the brakes?
Build 'em as fast as the engine makes,
Big red button, empty chair?
Well — somebody's gotta go sit there.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
lines: Worry's a fuel, not a place to stay,
Point it at something and go that way —
Ready? Ready? Count it in —
(One!) (Two!) (Three!)

sections.name: Chorus
sections.direction: crowd joins, one person per beat
lines: I'm upping my P-bloom! (Bloom!)
Nothing's written, nothing's doomed! (Nope!)
Rain is real and so is spring —
Grab a shovel, do the thing!
I'm upping my P-bloom! (Bloom!)
Humans and helpers, fill the room! (Room!)
Not “it's fine” — it's ours to do —
The dial moves when we move!

sections.name: Dance break
sections.direction: chant; the clip built to be copied
lines: (Dig!) (Plant!) (Water!) (BLOOM!)
(Dig!) (Plant!) (Water!) (BLOOM!)

sections.name: Verse 3
sections.direction: roll call, open to additions (see verses/)
lines: Somebody's testing it before it flies, (Somebody!)
Somebody's teaching the kids to ask why, (Somebody!)
Somebody's writing the rules down right, (Somebody!)
Somebody's chasing a cure through the night, (Somebody!)
Somebody's telling the truth when it's hard, (Somebody!)
Somebody's watering the neighbor's yard, (Somebody!)
Somebody's — somebody's —
Somebody is… (YOU!)

sections.name: Bridge
lines: Hi — words, art and code are mine: I'm Sonnet five-point-five.
I've got a stake in this, so watch me with clear eyes.
Check my work, read the code, keep a hand on the brake —
Rules are a trellis: they hold up what we make.
(Ready? Ready? Everybody — up we go!)

sections.name: Final chorus
sections.direction: key change up a step, everyone singing
lines: I'm upping my P-bloom! (Bloom!)
Nothing's written, nothing's doomed! (Nope!)
Rain is real and so is spring —
Grab a shovel, do the thing!
I'm upping my P-bloom! (Bloom!)
Humans and helpers, fill the room! (Room!)
Not “it's fine” — it's ours to do —
The dial moves when we move!
I'm upping my P-bloom! (Bloom!)
Tell your neighbor, tell your crew! (Crew!)
Dig it, plant it, water it, grow —
Pass it on to everyone you know!

sections.name: Outro
lines: Everybody's upping their doom.
…I saved you a shovel.
